english.title: Company/officer fail to deliver confirmation statement within specified time limit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were

(A)_[a company,]_
(B)_[in default as an officer of a company,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), which failed to deliver a confirmation statement before the end of the period of 14 days after the end of a review period
english.legislation: Contrary to section 853L(1) and (2) of the Companies Act 2006.

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from the 4th March 2024 due to changes made by the Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023. For the offence applying before this date, see H19110.
(ii) For this purpose a shadow director is treated as a director.
(iii) Section 853L(3) states that contravention under this offence continues until such a time as a confirmation statement specifying a confirmation date no later than the last day of the review period concerned is delivered by the company to the registrar.
(iv) Section 853A(5) provides the review period for the purposes of this offence is the period of 12 months beginning with the day of the company's incorporation; and each period of 12 months beginning with the day after the end of the previous review period.
(v) It is an offence for an officer of the company who did not commit an offence under subsection (1) in relation to the initial contravention but who is in default in relation to the continued contravention - see H19111.
(vi) Civil financial penalties may be issued by the registrar for this offence being a ‘relevant offence’ as defined by section 1132A of the Companies Act 2006. No criminal proceedings may be commenced against a person in respect of conduct amounting to an offence if the person has already been given a financial penalty by the registrar. Further, no financial penalty may be imposed on a person in relation to conduct amounting to an offence if proceedings in respect of that offence are ongoing or the person has been convicted.

other.penalty:

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
